overview: Close the highest-value tracker gap between the web workbench tracker and the Expo mobile app by adding project create/edit, metadata management, richer issue field parity, templates, and my-issues style surfaces.

scopeCuts: Focus on user-facing tracker parity inside mobile tracker routes, hooks, repositories, and adjacent components
Do not port workspace-admin tracker configuration or permission management

prerequisites: Scaffold, auth, API client, and current tracker phases are already implemented in mobile/
mobile-richtext should be complete before rich description editing is called done
mobile-attachments should be complete before attachment parity is called done
nonGoals: Rebuilding the full workbench viewlet/filter architecture on mobile
Porting tracker workspace settings screens from Svelte one-to-one
Changing server-side tracker models or web tracker behavior
contracts: Server state stays in TanStack Query; draft/preferences stay in Zustand
New tracker routes stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/tracker/**
Create/edit forms must block submission when required project metadata is unavailable

tasks.title: Expand tracker repository parity contract
tasks.description: Add repository methods for project detail, members, components, milestones, relations, template summaries, and time-report mutations so later UI tasks share one domain contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes typed read methods for project detail, components, milestones, members, and issue relations.
Repository exposes typed write methods for project create/update, component create/update, milestone create/update, and issue time reporting.
Missing or archived project-scoped entities return typed failures instead of raw transport errors.

tasks.title: Extend tracker hooks for parity data and mutations
tasks.description: Wire the expanded repository contract into TanStack Query for project metadata, relations, templates, and mutation invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Hooks expose project detail, component, milestone, template, and relation queries without screens calling repositories directly.
Project, component, milestone, and issue-field mutations invalidate the exact project and issue keys they affect.
Disabled queries remain inert when projectId or issueId is absent.

tasks.title: Expand tracker store for full issue/project draft state
tasks.description: Extend the tracker Zustand store to carry component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, template, and attachment draft fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft state includes component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, template selection, and attachment ids.
Clearing the draft resets all parity fields.
Persisted state does not leak stale project-specific selections across workspace changes.

tasks.title: Add project create/edit flow
tasks.description: Introduce a mobile project form and route so tracker parity includes project creation and editing with mobile-relevant defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracker index exposes create/edit project entry points and the edit route resolves with typed params.
Project form supports name, identifier, privacy, default assignee, and default issue status.
Invalid or duplicate identifiers surface a recoverable validation state instead of closing the form.

tasks.title: Add component and milestone management surfaces
tasks.description: Bring project-scoped tracker metadata management to mobile so issue forms and filters can use real project entities.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can view and create/edit project components and milestones from mobile tracker routes.
Lists render human-readable labels and metadata with proper empty states.
Archived or deleted entities are excluded from selection lists after mutation invalidation.

tasks.title: Bring issue detail to field parity
tasks.description: Upgrade issue detail into the parity screen for component, milestone, parent/sub-issue, relation, due date, estimation, time spent, and attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders editable component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, relations, and sub-issue summaries using real lookup data.
Time-report creation and refresh update reported-time UI without forcing a full app reload.
Missing related docs or deleted parents show safe fallback rows instead of raw refs or crashes.

tasks.title: Bring create/edit issue flow to parity
tasks.description: Upgrade issue creation into a shared create/edit form that supports the parity field set and proper project defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared form supports status, priority, assignee, component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, description markup, and attachments.
Edit mode preloads existing issue state and preserves parity fields when saving partial changes.
Submission is blocked when required project defaults or parity metadata are still loading.

tasks.title: Add issue templates flow
tasks.description: Expose tracker issue templates on mobile so users can start from the same reusable tracker patterns available on the web.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile tracker exposes a template list with project-scoped template summaries and empty/error states.
Selecting a template hydrates the create form draft without discarding manual overrides.
Templates that reference missing metadata surface a blocking explanation instead of creating malformed issues.

tasks.title: Add my-issues and advanced filter parity
tasks.description: Close the remaining day-to-day parity gap by adding a personal issue entry point and richer filters for list/search surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes a dedicated My Issues surface scoped to the authenticated user.
Filters include component, milestone, assignee, due date, and relation-aware combinations without raw-id rendering.
Clearing or restoring saved filters resets both list and search results consistently.

failureModes.detection: Form has no valid status or default assignee context
failureModes.recovery: Block submit and show explicit metadata-loading state

failureModes.failure: Deleted milestone/component referenced by an issue
failureModes.detection: Detail screen receives missing related doc
failureModes.recovery: Render safe fallback row and offer reassignment
Stop hydration and show template repair message

failureModes.failure: Time-report mutation succeeds but detail stays stale
failureModes.detection: Reported time does not update after save
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate issue detail and project issue list keys together

failureModes.detection: Issue form opens with wrong project metadata
failureModes.recovery: Clear persisted tracker draft when workspace identity changes

delivers: full issue create/edit/detail parity for core fields
safeToDefer: advanced filters beyond the current list/search core

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: repository contract + typed failure handling
TASK-002: query invalidation and disabled-query behavior
TASK-003: persisted draft/reset behavior across workspace changes
TASK-004: project form success + duplicate identifier failure path
TASK-005: component/milestone CRUD success + archived-entity exclusion
TASK-006: issue detail edit flow + missing-related-doc fallback
TASK-007: create/edit form submission gating + preloaded edit state
TASK-008: template hydration + stale-template failure path
TASK-009: my-issues scoping + filter clear/restore consistency
